sources: Business Standard, The Week/PTI, Goodreturns, 5paisa, Kotak Neo, IANS (Nov 5–8, 2026)

slides.title: Samvat 2083 opens *flat* after a losing year
An early *rally faded*
points: **Sun Pharma and Tata Steel** led gains; **M&M, Infosys and IndiGo** dragged
The Nifty slipped back **below 25,000** after a positive start
The one-hour session opened **Samvat 2083**, the new Hindu financial year

why.t: Foreigners sold more than in any recent Samvat
Record domestic buying cushioned the fall
A record ₹2.23 lakh cr raised via 375 IPOs
West Asia tensions kept crude near $100

slides.title: What moved, what to *watch*
actual: **Early pop faded:** Sensex rose 414 pts, then ended 28 pts lower
**Pharma, metals led:** Sun Pharma, Tata Steel gained
watch: **FPI flows** after a year of record selling
slides.note: Smallcap 100 trades at 34x earnings vs 21x for the Nifty 50. Muhurat sessions are short and symbolic.

slides.title: What investors should *know*
points: Samvat 2083 opened **flat**: an early rally faded and the Nifty closed below 25,000
In Samvat 2082, **small and mid caps beat** the Sensex and Nifty, which fell 3–4%
**Record DII buying** offset record FPI selling; watch foreign flows and crude
